title: Backend System Showcase
subtitle: Five repositories, one backend ecosystem: feature flags, audit logs, payments, an AI assistant and a proactive monitoring agent working together.
intro: A payment is created in Payment Tracking, the state change is logged automatically in the Audit Log System, the AI Admin Assistant summarizes the day in plain language, and the eve Audit Agent watches all of it in the background, without being asked. Feature Flags Dashboard plays a more independent role: it controls its own app's behavior per user context, and a flag toggle is one of the action types the shared audit trail can record.

featureFlags.name: Feature Flags Dashboard
featureFlags.role: Controls application behavior per user context, with a plain-language "why is this flag ON" explanation.

auditLog.name: Audit Log System
auditLog.role: Traces every user action with a timeline UI, replay and suspicious activity detection.

paymentTracking.name: Payment Tracking System
paymentTracking.role: Payment lifecycle state machine with refunds and receipt linking.

aiAdmin.name: AI Admin Assistant
aiAdmin.role: Natural language queries over the audit logs and payments, backed by real business data.

eveAgent.name: eve Audit Agent
eveAgent.role: Proactive agent that watches Supabase events in real time and reports anomalies with a human approval gate.

architecture.heading: Architecture
architecture.description: No service bindings, no message queue: every project in this ecosystem talks to the same Supabase project, each owning a different slice of it: users (Feature Flags Dashboard), audit_logs (Audit Log System), payments/payment_events/receipts (Payment Tracking System) and eve_agent_log (eve Audit Agent). The AI Admin Assistant and this hub don't own a table, they only read across all of them.
